description:
Cast Endless One by paying {0}.
Endless One enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Endless One from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Endless One from your library, and gain 1 life.
Repeat.
